actor.description: The actor whose attestation threshold is being changed. Must agree with the envelope subject. Cross-actor threshold change is invalid.

subject.description: Internal reference of the same actor: 'actor:<self-actor-id>'.

created_at.description: Strict RFC 3339 UTC seconds (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). Defines the causal position at which new_threshold takes effect.

new_threshold.description: The new attestation threshold. MUST satisfy 1 <= new_threshold <= |attestation_set at created_at|. A change exceeding the available key count is invalid (would brick recovery).

signatures.description: Required signature count depends on the direction of the change at created_at. Raises (new > current) require >= max(current, new) distinct attestation signatures; lowers (new < current) and no-ops require >= current. Each signature must come from a distinct key_id in the attestation set at created_at. See ACTORS.md §5.5.3.
